description: End-to-end performance and reliability management workflow for an API gateway, including SLO definition, monitoring, anomaly detection, canary policies, rollback, and capacity optimization.

api_id.description: Unique identifier of an API managed by the gateway

route_id.description: Identifier of a specific route/endpoint within an API

deployment_id.description: Identifier for a deployed version/configuration of an API

slo_id.description: Identifier for a Service Level Objective configuration

policy_id.description: Identifier for a performance or traffic management policy

incident_id.description: Identifier for a performance incident or degradation event

timeseries_query_id.description: Identifier for a saved performance or usage query

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: define_api_slo
functions.description: Define or update Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets for an API or specific routes.

api_id.description: Target API for which the SLO is defined.

scope.description: Scope of the SLO, either global for the API or route specific.

level.description: Whether the SLO applies to the entire API or a specific route.

route_id.description: Route to which the SLO applies when level is 'route'.

slo_name.description: Human-readable name for the SLO definition.

measurement_window.description: Time window used to evaluate availability.

error_budget_policy.description: How error budget consumption is evaluated and acted upon.

max_consumption_percentage.description: Maximum percentage of error budget that can be consumed within the measurement window.

alert_thresholds.description: Alert thresholds based on error budget consumption.

threshold_percentage.description: Error budget consumption percentage at which to trigger alerts.

notification_channels.description: Notification channels to use when threshold is exceeded.

max_latency_ms.description: Maximum allowed latency in milliseconds at this percentile.

measurement_window.description: Time window used to aggregate latency metrics.

max_rps.description: Maximum requests per second allowed before throttling is recommended.

burst_rps.description: Short-term burst requests per second tolerated without throttling.

conditions.description: Conditions when SLO is applicable or excluded.

excluded_status_codes.description: HTTP status codes to exclude from SLO calculations.

included_client_ids.description: Client IDs to include for SLO calculation. If empty, applies to all.

traffic_segments.description: Optional traffic segment rules the SLO applies to.

metadata.description: Additional metadata for the SLO definition.

slo_id.description: Existing SLO ID to update. Omit to create a new SLO.

functions.returns: SLO ID, effective configuration, and validation results.

functions.name: configure_performance_monitoring
functions.description: Configure metrics collection, aggregation, and anomaly detection settings for an API or deployment.

api_id.description: API for which monitoring is being configured.

deployment_id.description: Specific deployment of the API. If omitted, applies to all deployments.

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain raw metrics.

static_thresholds.description: Static thresholds rules applied when mode is 'static_thresholds'.

duration.description: How long the condition must hold, e.g., '5m', '15m'.

learning_window.description: How far back to learn baseline behavior (e.g., '7d').

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity of anomaly detection; higher is more sensitive.

min_traffic_rps.description: Minimum load required to evaluate anomalies.

notification_rules.description: Rules for notifying stakeholders when anomalies or SLO breaches occur.

recipients.description: List of recipients or endpoints for notifications.

functions.returns: Monitoring configuration object and validation status.

functions.name: run_performance_diagnostics
functions.description: Run an on-demand performance diagnostics job for an API or route over a given time range.

route_id.description: If specified, diagnostics will focus on this route.

preset.description: Optional preset that overrides from/to when provided.

focus.description: Specific aspects to analyze in detail.

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow down the diagnostics.

functions.returns: Diagnostics report with latency distributions, error breakdowns, top offenders, and suggested remediation actions.

functions.name: list_api_performance_summaries
functions.description: List performance summaries for multiple APIs and deployments with filtering and pagination.

time_window.description: Time window over which to compute summaries.

functions.returns: Paginated list of APIs with performance and SLO status summaries.

functions.name: create_traffic_shaping_policy
functions.description: Create or update a traffic shaping policy (rate limiting, throttling, and QoS) for an API or route.

rules.description: List of rules that make up the traffic shaping policy.

match.description: Conditions under which this rule applies.

limits.description: Limit values applied when rule matches.

priority.description: Relative priority when scheduling requests; lower is higher priority.

action.description: Whether to enforce the limits or only log potential violations.

fallback_policy_id.description: Optional ID of another policy to fall back to in case of misconfiguration.

policy_id.description: Existing policy ID to update; omit to create a new policy.

functions.returns: Policy ID, validation results, and effective rule summary.

functions.name: simulate_policy_impact
functions.description: Simulate the impact of a traffic shaping or canary policy using historical traffic patterns.

policy_id.description: ID of an existing policy to simulate.

policy_draft.description: Temporary policy definition to simulate without saving.

simulation_window.description: Time range of historical data to replay.

traffic_growth_percentage.description: Assumed traffic growth compared to historical data.

error_rate_multiplier.description: Factor by which to multiply observed error rates.

functions.returns: Simulation report with projected latency, error rate, throttling events, and SLO impact.

functions.name: configure_canary_release
functions.description: Configure and start a canary release between two deployments with automated rollback conditions.

baseline_deployment_id.description: Stable deployment receiving the remaining traffic.

candidate_deployment_id.description: New deployment gradually receiving more traffic.

traffic_plan.description: Progressive traffic allocation to the candidate.

automatic_promotion.description: Whether to auto-advance to the next step if criteria are met.

guardrails.description: Performance and error conditions preventing promotion or triggering rollback.

max_relative_latency_increase_pct.description: Maximum allowed percentage increase compared to baseline latency.

max_error_rate_increase_pct.description: Maximum allowed percentage increase in error rate.

absolute_error_rate_threshold.description: Absolute error rate at which rollback is triggered.

min_traffic_rps.description: Minimum RPS required for statistical significance.

slo_id.description: Optional SLO used as an additional gate for promotion and rollback.

functions.returns: Canary release policy ID, initial step status, and monitoring hooks.

functions.name: get_performance_status
functions.description: Get current performance status, SLO compliance, and health indicators for an API or deployment.

include.description: Additional sections to include in the response.

functions.returns: Snapshot of key performance indicators, SLO status, incidents, and canary/traffic policy states.

functions.name: open_performance_incident
functions.description: Open a performance incident based on anomalies, SLO breaches, or manual reports.

details.description: Detailed description, including observed behavior and potential root cause.

initial_mitigation_actions.description: Optional list of mitigation actions already taken.

functions.returns: Incident ID, initial status, and linked SLOs/policies.

functions.name: apply_emergency_rollback
functions.description: Perform an emergency rollback of a problematic deployment or canary to the last known good state.

current_deployment_id.description: Deployment that is currently serving traffic and causing issues.

target_strategy.description: Which deployment to roll back to.

target_deployment_id.description: Specific deployment to roll back to when strategy is 'specific_deployment'.

traffic_shift.description: How to shift traffic during rollback.

safety_checks.description: Safety checks to perform before fully committing to the rollback.

reason.description: Reasoning or context for the rollback.

functions.returns: Rollback operation ID, new active deployment, and rollback progress status.

functions.name: tune_capacity_and_scaling
functions.description: Recommend and optionally apply capacity and autoscaling changes based on observed performance and forecasts.

cost_sensitivity.description: How aggressively to optimize for cost vs. performance.

current_scaling_config.description: Current autoscaling configuration (optional, can be fetched from system).

apply_changes.description: Whether to automatically apply the recommended changes.

dry_run.description: If true, recommendations are generated without any side effects.

functions.returns: Recommended scaling configuration, projected impact on cost and performance, and application status if changes are applied.

functions.name: save_and_run_timeseries_query
functions.description: Create or update a saved timeseries performance query, then execute it to retrieve metrics.

query_id.description: Existing query ID to update; omit to create a new one.

definition.description: Query definition specifying metrics, dimensions, filters, and aggregations.

functions.returns: Timeseries_query_id, stored definition, and query results for the requested time range.

functions.name: retry_performance_operation
functions.description: Retry a previously failed or partial performance-related control operation such as canary promotion, rollback, or policy update.

operation_id.description: Identifier of the previous operation to retry.

retry_strategy.description: How the retry should be performed.

scheduled_time.description: Time at which to start the retry when mode is 'scheduled'.

override_parameters.description: Optional subset of parameters to override from the original operation, e.g., safer guardrails.

guardrails.description: Override guardrail thresholds for canary or rollback.

traffic_step_size.description: Override traffic increment size for canary promotion.

reason.description: Reason or context for performing the retry.

functions.returns: New operation ID, scheduled or immediate execution status, and any conflicts with current state.

functions.name: api_performance_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import api performance entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: api_performance_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many api performance entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: api_performance_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many api performance entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: api_performance_bulk_export
functions.description: Export api performance entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: api_performance_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across api performance entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: api_performance_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for api performance events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: api_performance_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for api performance notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: api_performance_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more api performance entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: api_performance_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to api performance on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: api_performance_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a api performance operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: api_performance_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending api performance change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: api_performance_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending api performance approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: api_performance_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a api performance entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: api_performance_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a api performance entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: api_performance_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a api performance entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: api_performance_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a api performance entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: api_performance_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for api performance activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: api_performance_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a api performance view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: api_performance_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to api performance entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: api_performance_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given api performance payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: api_performance_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a api performance entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: api_performance_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a api performance entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
